title: Rangka work screen
description: A work screen a module ships in screens/<name>.rk (contract 0030): one staff job on a phone or tablet, rendered by the web app from one of seven types. It writes only through the record API, so permissions, row scope, rules, flows and approvals apply as for a form.

roles.description: Roles that may open the screen (the owner always may)

needs.description: Device capabilities; the screen still opens without them, with a notice

if.description: CEL over user (and org, tax); false hides the screen

block.description: The slots of a type whose renderer is not built yet; its PR gives the block its own shape (contract 0030 §2)

set.description: field: CEL over user, org, tax, today() and now(), evaluated by the kernel when the screen opens

entry.description: A short phone form: fill, save, next (contract 0030 §2)

submit.description: Submit the record after saving it (the model must be submittable)

again.description: After saving, open an empty form again (default true)
